Remark
[Misner completeness implies completeness]

Source: petersen:page-0238 ↗ def:pet-ch5-geodesically-complete 1. ch5:5.9.6Call $(M,g)$ Misner complete if every geodesic $c:(a,b)\to M$ with $b-a<\infty $ lies in a compact set. Show Misner completeness implies completeness.
